description: Create a manually-managed crypto asset. The symbol must match one returned by get_supported_cryptocurrencies.

balance.description: Balance as a numeric string with up to 18 decimal places, e.g. '0.852341920145782301'. Pass a string to avoid losing precision.

display_name.description: Optional display name. If omitted or null, clients may derive one from institution_name and name.

institution_name.description: Optional institution or wallet provider display name, e.g. 'Ledger'. If omitted or null, no institution name is set.

name.description: User-defined name for the manual crypto asset, e.g. 'Cold Wallet BTC'.

symbol.description: Cryptocurrency symbol to track, e.g. 'btc'. Must match a symbol from get_supported_cryptocurrencies.

name: create_manual_crypto
